title: Unit Event — MORE MORE Making Christmas — Episode5 Very First Steps

meta.Event Outline: Following the success of the elementary school event, the girls start planning for another show in real life, but encounter various obstacles along the way. Just when things seem difficult, they receive an email from a fan offering to help. Minori is thrilled, but...

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I thought really long and hard yesterday about whether or not it's okay for us to have our fans work behind the scenes for us...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I mean long. Really long...
And I arrived on this.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: When I was still just a fan of you, Haruka, I only ever saw the idol that dazzled everyone... I thought that it must be wonderful to be on stage like that.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You're probably right that I wouldn't have been able to enjoy being a fan and thought that it must be hard being an idol if I saw what's on the other side.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So I do understand your position regarding us having our fans see that.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But this is what I really think!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Fans don't just want to see idols shine and sparkle.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I mean that fans will be there to support their favorite idols through thick and thin! They'll cheer for them no matter what if it means they'll keep shining!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: B-But that's also just the way I am...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka, do you remember when that ASRUN event got canceled because it was so windy...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Right as you started making your way backstage, you had this really sad look on your face...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That's when I thought this.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Isn't there anything I can do to help cheer up Haruka and ASRUN...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You were there, Minori...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Unlike you guys, the event at that elementary school was my first and I still probably don't understand yet just how hard everyone on the other side has to work...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But I'm guessing that the person who sent us that email feels the same way...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Even if they see what's on the other side...No, by seeing the other side, they'll be willing to support us even more! So please...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I understand, Minori...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So that means...?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But that's just your opinion.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What do you plan on doing if or when our fans aren't able to enjoy things as fans after seeing the other side?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: W-We'll...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We'll just try again...!!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: If that happens, we'll just have to try even harder than before to make sure they all have fun again!!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We can do more streams, interact more with our fans and dazzle them even more...! We'll just have to find more ways to spread hope as idols!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: By doing that, I'm sure they'll still be able to feel that spark after seeing the “reality” you were talking about!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Find more ways, huh...?
No plan as usual.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. But it's very you, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I-I'm so sorry...!
I couldn't come up with anything else...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But I promise to do everything I can for the people we hire as our staff!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Because I'm certain that doing this will become a really special memory for them in the end!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It'll be a special experience for them since they'll get to see their favorite idols smile by making their event a success.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: There's probably no better feeling in the world than when that happens.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Was I worrying too much...?)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Did I put myself in a corner by focusing too much on the consequences of this “choice”?)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (All the while, Minori...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (She truly believes in our fans.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (They won't be brought down by seeing what's real. They'll be willing to face this if it means we're smiling in the end.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Why don't we give it a try?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Gasp*...!
R-Really...?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yes.
But you should also be asking Airi and Shizuku this.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: S-So, what do you think...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I think Haruka's right in terms of how we all think about fans differently, but I also understand how you feel, Minori...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: As long as there are fans out there who are willing to support us, I'll do whatever I can to answer their call...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I wasn't sure which was the right answer either...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But I can't help but wonder if Minori's right about how our fans may want to support us even more by putting on this even...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So I think we should believe in them and take this chance.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Understood...
Then, let's tell Saito about our decision.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
O-Okay...!
Thank you all so much!!
The next day

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey, we got a response about helping us with our event!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What?! Already?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That's wonderful. She must've been wanting to help us just that much.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Also, she said, <Would it be possible for us to have a video conference?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'd like to do that today if it's alright with you guys.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right... We'll be able to share information much more quickly by doing this as opposed to replying through email.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: B-But a video conference with one of our fans...! I'm so nervous!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You're joking, right? If we ask her for help, we'll probably be meeting every day from here on out.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Anyway, <Yes, we'd love to.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, looks like she's ready to talk now...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Gasp*...!
Everything's moving so fast...!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
<Oh... Hello!
I'm Ayaka Saito. It's nice to finally meet you!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Uh... H-Hello!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Nice to meet you, Saito.
Haruka Kiritani here.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: First, allow me to thank you for your generous offer. We really appreciate your help.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: <No, it's my pleasure! I apologize for sending you such a shady-looking email completely out of the blue... But thank you very much for replying!>

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: <Th-This is so cool...!! I'm talking to the real deal...!! Excuse me, I need a drink of water... *Cough*... Hack!>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, are you alright?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wait, I've definitely seen this before...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I know how she feels! I get so nervous when talking to idols too!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
<Pardon me. Thank you for waiting!
I'm all better now!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Anyway, shall we get started?
There are quite a few questions that we'd like to ask you.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: <Yes, please!>

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: <I see. So you're hoping to do a meet and greet, a talk show and a mini-concert at the Okuyama Building's underground hall in Shibuya, which holds up to 500 people...>

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: <Based on that, I think you're going to need a few more hands helping out...>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: <I have six MMJ fans among my friends, so my original plan was to have two of them be receptionists, four on crowd control and me overseeing everything...>

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: <But if you're looking at a 500-person hall, it'd be nice to have some extra hands on board as insurance since you're thinking about doing a meet and greet...>

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: <My estimate would be ten... No, fifteen more people...>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's easier said than done. We've been having a hard time ourselves since the holidays are coming up...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I know this isn't the best plan, but what if we lower the number of people that can attend? Wouldn't that allow us to work with what we have...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Right...
That is an option...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Or... What if we asked our fans?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: During our stream with Hayakawa, I remember seeing some comments mentioning how they want to help and to let them know if we ever need them.

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<Can't we help them somehow?!>
<I believe in MMJ!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We've chosen to accept the help of some fans already, so I think we can ask a few more for their help...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Of course, not everyone will have experience like you, Saito, so there are some risks attached to this. They may even hesitate to do this as a result...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But they're here to support us, which means they genuinely want to help us, right, Minori...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (She's right. What if there are other fans out there like Saito and me...?)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! Okay, let's try asking them!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Alright. Then, how about we start recruiting staff for our event once we have a plan all lined up?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
That seems fine.
Let's do everything we can to show our fans just how much we appreciate them!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah!
